title: AA-2024-7142-PM-HCA-1A
text:
AA-2024-7142-PM-HCA-1A  Council District: 12 – Lee

  CEQA: ENV-2024-7143-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-17-26
  Plan Area: Chatsworth – Porter Ranch  Continued from: 08-20-26; 09-03-26

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  21126 and 21128 West Chatsworth Street

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  The subdivision of one parcel into four parcels on a 78,026.5 gross square foot lot in the RA-1 Zone. There
  is an existing single-family dwelling proposed for demolition as a part of the Project. No grading and no
  construction are proposed. There are 43 trees on-site, three of which are Los Angeles Native Protected
  Trees. 15 trees are proposed for removal, none of which are Protected Trees.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the May 28, 2026 Deputy Advisory Agency's determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15315, Class 15,
  and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a categorical exemption
  pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15300.2 applies.
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Sections 17.51 and 17.53 and Chapter 1A Section 13B.7.5 of the
  Los Angeles Municipal Code, Parcel Map No. AA-2024-7142-PM-HCA located at 21126 and 21128
  West Chatsworth Street, for the subdivision of one lot into four lots on a 78,026.5 gross square foot lot
  in the RA-1 Zone;
  3. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Raz and Keren Ben-Aharon
  Representative: Camille Zeitouny, Zeitouny & Associates Inc.

  *Appellant:  Marianne King

  Staff:  Shane Strunk, Planning Assistant
  shane.strunk@lacity.org
  (213) 675-6022
summary: Appeal of Deputy Advisory Agency's approval for subdivision of one parcel into four parcels at 21126 and 21128 West Chatsworth Street.
